verification.subject: Your OTP Verification Code for MKHE
verification.instruction: To complete your registration, please enter the OTP code below:
verification.footer:
Sent at: {time}
This code expires in 15 minutes. Please do not share this code.
verification.noShare: Do not share this code with anyone.

resetPassword.subject: Reset Your Password at MKHE
resetPassword.instruction: We received a request to reset your password.
resetPassword.footer:
Sent at: {time}
If you did not request this, please ignore this email.
resetPassword.ignored: If you did not request this, ignore this email.

blockAccount.subject: Account Locked Notification from MKHE
blockAccount.accountLocked: Your account has been locked for the following reason:
blockAccount.support: If you believe this is a mistake, please contact MKHE support team.

changePassword.subject: Change password OTP at MKHE
changePassword.instruction: We received a request to change the password for your account. Please enter the OTP below to verify:
changePassword.footer:
Sent at: {time}
This code will expire in 10 minutes. If you did not request a password change, please secure your account immediately.
changePassword.ignored: If you did not make this request, please change your password or contact support.

checkoutOtp.subject: Order Confirmation OTP at MKHE
checkoutOtp.instruction: You are processing an order checkout at MKHE. Please enter the OTP below to confirm (for COD method):
checkoutOtp.footer:
Sent at: {time}
This code expires in 10 minutes. Do not share this code.
checkoutOtp.ignored: If you are not placing an order, please ignore this email.

invoice.subject: Order Confirmation #{orderCode} from MKHE
invoice.intro: Your order has been confirmed. Here are the details:
invoice.footer:
Sent at: {time}
Thank you for choosing MKHE Heritage.

b2bActivation.subject: Activate Enterprise Account - MKHE B2B Portal
b2bActivation.instruction: Your Enterprise account has been successfully created. Please click the button below to set up your password and activate your account.

contactConfirmation.subject: Confirmation of your contact request to MKHE
contactConfirmation.instruction: We have received your contact request. Our team will review it and get back to you as soon as possible.
contactConfirmation.footer:
Sent at: {time}
Thank you for your interest in MKHE Heritage.

adminContactNotification.subject: New contact request from {name}
adminContactNotification.instruction: There is a new contact request in the system:
adminContactNotification.name: Name:
adminContactNotification.footer:
Sent at: {time}
Please contact the customer as soon as possible.
